info.prompt: Close-up of a cyber-gothic gambler’s interface where bone-white dials marked with alchemical sigils adjust the "HALL OF MIRRORS" acoustic decoration—the resulting soundwaves manifest as fracturing glass panes that multiply the dice’s reflections into infinity, each duplicate die showing a different historical era (medieval bone, steampunk brass, nanotech swarm) while the background’s void-black expanse flickers with neural static, briefly revealing the ghostly outline of some immense cathedral ribcage before dissolving back into digital noise.
